# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Thanks, Aarav. I can help — before I take any actions I need a few required details and your explicit confirmation.

Please provide:

2) Confirm that the credit card ending in 7334 is already saved in your profile and that you want any charges/refunds to go to that card.

4) For reservation M20IZO: do you want me to search for nonstop options on the same date(s) currently booked? 5) Do you want refunds to go back to the original payment methods (typical) if those reservations are refundable?

- Retrieve the three reservation details,
- Confirm whether each cancellation/change is allowed under policy (and whether any segment has already flown),
- List the exact actions I’ll take and any charges/refunds (amounts and payment method),
- Then I will need your explicit “yes” to proceed.

Please supply the requested info and confirm you want me to continue.
